label: Chart View
description: Renders a Chart.js canvas from a Chart Builder page-value key.

properties.name: component_name
properties.label: Reusable component name
properties.help: Leave empty to render inline. Set a name to create a reusable component file.

properties.name: data_key
properties.label: Chart data key
properties.help: Must match the Chart Builder Page value key.

properties.name: css_class
properties.label: Wrapper CSS classes
properties.help: Optional outer wrapper classes. Leave both wrapper fields empty to render only the chart component.

properties.name: inline_style
properties.label: Wrapper inline styles
properties.help: Optional outer wrapper styles. Leave both wrapper fields empty to render only the chart component.

properties.name: chart_js_source
properties.label: Custom Chart.js path
properties.help: Optional local or remote script URL. Leave empty to use the bundled assets/js/chart.min.js file copied into the generated plugin.

properties.name: widths
properties.label: Responsive width
properties.help: Applied only when wrapper classes or wrapper inline styles are provided.
